diagnostics.title: Report a problem
diagnostics.summary: BlinkTable builds this report locally. Nothing is uploaded automatically — choose Copy, Save, or Open issue yourself.
diagnostics.no_screenshots: The report never includes screenshots, images, or file contents.
diagnostics.preview_label: Report contents (exactly what will be copied or attached):
diagnostics.unclean_body: The previous session ended without a normal exit. A diagnostics report would include the end of the previous log and, if the app crashed hard, the crash traceback. Nothing is sent automatically — you choose Copy, Save, or Open issue.

action.create_report_desc: Build a local diagnostics report and choose Copy / Save / Open issue.
